notes: Unity Ludum Dare 46 entry Shrouded in Darkness. After darkness falls, protect your brother and the campfire from forest demons; includes Player/Ghost/DialogSystem/GameManager scripts and GameScene. MIT (copyright 2020 Deseteral <deseteral@gmail.com>). Playable on itch.io (https://deseteral.itch.io/shrouded-in-darkness). Font Assets/Fonts/MarckScript-Regular.ttf is Marck Script (Denis Masharov / Google Fonts, SIL OFL; no separate OFL.txt in-repo). WAV SFX and promo_assets included under the MIT grant. No EXE/DLL/LFS/Mannequin/InsertPack/StarterContent/EmojiOne/TMP assets/AssetStore. ~30MB src snapshot.
